issue: विश्वनाथ धरत ध्यान शरण हैं तुम्हारी — विश्वनाथ may be Śiva (Lord of the universe) or the poet’s signature; Drik Panchang reads … ध्यान हम हैं शरण तुम्हारी.
our reading: Viśvanātha (kept as the name) meditates on you and is in your refuge
alternatives: Śiva meditates on you; or the poet Viśvanātha (with Drik Panchang: we are in your refuge)
